notes.title: LevelEditor Update
notes.content:
You can make your own map with the level editor now!

Guide:
Left mouse buttonL: Select and edit
Right mouse button: Rotate the view
RMB+W,S,A,D: Move camera arround
RMB+Shift,Spacebar: Move camera up and down
Number 1: Edit location
Number 2: Edit rotation
Number 3: Edit scale
Tab: Toggle between world space and object space
Ctrl+Z: Undo action
Ctrl+C: Copy
Ctrl+V: Paste
Ctrl+D: Duplicate(which means:Copy+Paste)
Click with Shift key down can select multiple objects.

Over the viewport you can change the snapping setting,the text will turn into red when the snapping is enabled.
On the down left corner, you can set up the weapon spawn rate, but dont forget to drag at least one "Weapon Spawn Area" into the world to make it work.you can click hide or show to change visibility of all Weapon Spawn Areas in the world.

notes.content:
New weapons:
Fans
Gloves
Catcher
Weapon remove:
Laser
MeteorHammer
The 2 weapons are way below my expectation,they are kind of useless in combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35024749/3e4a503372de8038787209ce9a471dce4b60b70e.png[/img]

Maps change:
Laser maps:
replace some laser with larger radius tunnel, so you can go up much more easier.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35024749/f41df876100dc53605112fe17580f80282aa375f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35024749/c0b903b09fcc989cec53137bd33cb0e7b9b5f0e5.png[/img]

Space maps:
After I try out the space maps, I think they didnt do very well on gameplay(althought they do look pretty).One reason is players' body part often block by the props, it results in bad movement feeling.And fighting is terrible in space, it's very hard to hit other player whatever you use weapon or fist,because they are flying so fast and it's impossible to aim them.Also many weapon cant use indoor, they become totally useless in space maps.

So, I come out with the new idea of space map:
System adjust: No gravity change to low gravity,and slow down some movement speed
Map structure:Setting up a border arroud the combat zone, player get kill when they get out,so every weapon is usable now in space.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35024749/b1be2ba052c3f5ee1b823ce5ac01281ee7bb0edf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35024749/b766b268ee7394e707e3ed3eaa0b16bb15270e47.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35024749/a3aaec54aecdf872939a59b2c59135af7be38e22.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35024749/8c7c30ad336c1f988f35b5b016aa73c78bc3e63a.png[/img]

I know currently they are not as pretty as before, but I believe they can do much better on gameplay.Check this out and leave me some feedback, this is not the final version and I will keep working on it.

notes.title: AI update
notes.content:
First generation AI test
AI won't pick up and use weapon currently,but it will be upgraded in the future update.

Easy:Low attack frequency,only engage in short distance
Normal:Hige attack frequency,pretty aggressive
Hard:Can block punck,kick and bullet.Will hold on when target player using shield

After host game, open pause menu,on the right side of screen,you can enable AI and adjust number and difficulty
